basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Junior Research Fellow (Civil Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University), has invited applications for 1 Junior Research Fellow post in the project "Characterization of Groundwater Depletion Induced Land Subsidence as a Function of Aquifer Properties by Spaceborne Geodetic Techniques including DGPS Observations and Dual Frequency NISAR", at Rs 37,000 a month with HRA @18%. The essential qualification is an M.E./M.Tech. or M.Sc. in the listed disciplines with a qualifying GATE/NET or equivalent national level examination. Applications are sent by email to [email protected]

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age. Relaxation of marks and age may be granted to OBC/SC/ST/Women/physically challenged candidates as per govt norms. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in Water Resources/Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS/Engineering Geosciences, OR M.Sc. degree in Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS, Geography/Geology/Applied Geology, Earth Sciences or equivalent. AND must have qualified GATE/ NET or any national level examination conducted by central government departments or institutes like DST, IIT, ISRO etc.

Prepare a single pdf file attaching all the requisite degrees/certificates.
Send the soft copy of the form with the supporting documents to [email protected] before the last date.
Write "Application for the post of" and the post applied (JRF) in the email subject.
Also fill and submit the Google form https://forms.gle/TiFMGAbZvKN4kN7GA.
Application Form (Annexure-I), which asks for personal details, GATE/CSIR-NET details with marks/rank and year, and academic records with attested copies of qualifying degrees enclosed.
Work experience, software proficiency, projects carried out and the number of SCI and non-SCI/conference publications, as asked in the form.
Declaration with date, place and signature.

For any query, contact Prof. Anurag Ohri, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT(BHU) Varanasi, email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About IIT (BHU) Civil Engineering NISAR Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Department of Civil Engineering of IIT (BHU), Varanasi, under Prof. Anurag Ohri, the Principal Investigator (PI) named on the notice. The project studies groundwater depletion induced land subsidence as a function of aquifer properties, using spaceborne geodetic techniques, DGPS observations and dual frequency NISAR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in Water Resources/Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS/Engineering Geosciences, OR M.Sc. degree in Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS, Geography/Geology/Applied Geology, Earth Sciences or equivalent. AND must have qualified GATE/ NET or any national level examination conducted by central government departments or institutes like DST, IIT, ISRO etc. Experience in SAR image processing, DGPS observations, GIS/Remote Sensing tools, and programming (Python); knowledge of groundwater modelling preferred. The upper age limit is 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age. Relaxation of marks and age may be granted to OBC/SC/ST/Women/physically challenged candidates as per govt norms. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is Rs 37,000/- with HRA @18%. IIT (BHU) has all rights to decide the duration of appointment in each position. The performance of project staff positions will be reviewed accordingly, and the positions may be extended for the total project duration. A selected candidate is expected to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (BHU) Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill the Application Form given as Annexure-I of the notice (with a recent passport size photograph). Prepare a single pdf file attaching all the requisite degrees/certificates. Send the soft copy of the form with the supporting documents to [email protected] before the last date. Write "Application for the post of" and the post applied (JRF) in the email subject. Also fill and submit the Google form https://forms.gle/TiFMGAbZvKN4kN7GA . Application Form (Annexure-I), which asks for personal details, GATE/CSIR-NET details with marks/rank and year, and academic records with attested copies of qualifying degrees enclosed. Work experience, software proficiency, projects carried out and the number of SCI and non-SCI/conference publications, as asked in the form. Declaration with date, place and signature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the PI is free to set the benchmark and call only the eligible candidates for Test and/or Interview for any position. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated to appear in the interview, and no other communication will be entertained. Candidates are requested to check their email regularly and visit https://www.iitbhu.ac.in/positions_available for updates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The PI reserves the right not to fill any of the posts advertised, in the event or exigency so decided, without assigning any reason. The PI reserves its right to increase or decrease the number of posts or not fill the position if no suitable candidate is found. For any query, contact Prof. Anurag Ohri, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT(BHU) Varanasi, email: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are advertised by IIT (BHU)?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 1 Junior Research Fellow post in the Department of Civil Engineering. The PI reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 16 December 2026. The starting date is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT (BHU) JRF post?
faq.answer: An M.E./M.Tech. in Water Resources/Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS/Engineering Geosciences, or an M.Sc. in Geoinformatics/Remote Sensing & GIS, Geography/Geology/Applied Geology, Earth Sciences or equivalent. The candidate must also have qualified GATE/ NET or another national level examination conducted by central government departments or institutes like DST, IIT, ISRO etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years. Relaxation of marks and age may be granted to OBC/SC/ST/Women/physically challenged candidates as per govt norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the JRF?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs 37,000/- with HRA @18%.

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the Rs 37,000?
faq.answer: The notice states the salary as Rs 37,000/- with HRA @18%. It names no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The PI may call only eligible candidates for Test and/or Interview. Only shortlisted candidates are informed about the interview.

faq.question: Q10. For how long is the appointment?
faq.answer: IIT (BHU) decides the duration of appointment. The position may be extended for the total project duration, after review of performance.
